sources_described: Surface water from Moody Gulch Stream; intake about one-half mile uphill, above and west of Highway 17 (Los Gatos). Treatment: cartridge filtration, slow sand filtration, chlorine disinfection. Report date June 27, 2026; contract operator Archer Engineering.
